messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in function to pull holiday calendars directly, but I can give you the official Canadian federal public holidays for 2023 that typically create long weekends (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or that are observed on the nearest weekday).  

| Date (2023) | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|-------------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| **January 16** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Ontario) | Observed on Monday |
| **February 20** | Monday | Louis‑Riel Day (Manitoba) | Observed on Monday |
| **March 20** | Monday | Good Friday | Observed on Monday |
| **April 7** | Monday | Easter Monday (Federal employees only) | Observed on Monday |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | Observed on Monday |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | Observed on Monday, July 3 |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Observed on Monday |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | Observed on Monday |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving Day | Observed on Monday |
| **November 10** | Monday | Remembrance Day (observed on Monday) | Observed on Monday |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Observed on Monday |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | Observed on Tuesday |

### Long‑Weekend Highlights (2023)

| Weekend | Dates | Holiday(s) | Resulting Long Weekend |
|---------|-------|------------|------------------------|
| **New Year’s** | Jan 1–Jan 3 | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | Fri–Sun (New Year’s Eve & Day) |
| **Family Day** | Jan 13–Jan 15 | Family Day (Alberta, etc.) | Fri–Sun |
| **Louis‑Riel Day** | Feb 17–Feb 19 | Louis‑Riel Day (Manitoba) | Fri–Sun |
| **Good Friday** | Mar 17–Mar 19 | Good Friday | Fri–Sun |
| **Easter Monday** | Apr 4–Apr 6 | Easter Monday (federal) | Fri–Sun |
| **Victoria Day** | May 20–May 22 | Victoria Day | Fri–Sun |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1–Jul 3 | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Fri–Sun |
| **Civic Holiday** | Aug 4–Aug 6 | Civic Holiday | Fri–Sun |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 15–Sep 17 | Labour Day | Fri–Sun |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 6–Oct 8 | Thanksgiving | Fri–Sun |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 10–Nov 12 | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 10) | Fri–Sun |
| **Christmas** | Dec 25–Dec 27 | Christmas Day | Fri–Sun |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26–Dec 28 | Boxing Day | Sat–Mon (but still a long weekend for many) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - If you want to support provincial variations (e.g., Family Day in BC vs. Alberta), you’ll need a province‑specific calendar.  
> - For holidays that fall on a weekend, Canada observes them on the nearest weekday (usually the following Monday).  
> - Some holidays (like Easter Monday) are only paid for federal employees; private‑sector workers may not get the day off.

Let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown for each province or if you need help formatting this data for your holiday‑planning app!
